snippet.title: Cozy Builder |Game Announcement Trailer| indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Cozy Builder now on Steam ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4059000/Cozy_Builder

Cozy Builder is a relaxing sandbox builder that lets you design and live inside your dream château in a sunlit vineyard valley. Explore modular building as you shape and decorate every corner of your home. Rebuild Cozy Vineyard Valley one home at a time,  and use gardening and artisanal crafting to bring the valley—and your next creation—to life. 

#cozygames
